rows.meaning: person who works land / keeps livestock
rows.note: This is the all-purpose term for a person who farms or keeps livestock.

example.english: My dad is a farmer and goes to the fields early every day.
example.traditional: 我阿爸係農夫，平日朝早就落田。
example.jyutping: ngo5 aa3 baa4 hai6 nung4 fu1 ping4 jat6 ziu1 zou2 zau6 lok6 tin4

rows.meaning: person who works land / keeps livestock
rows.note: Use this for an agricultural worker or farmer viewed as part of the farming population, especially in more formal contexts.

example.english: The government launched a new scheme to support every local farmer.
example.traditional: 政府推出新計劃，支援每個本地農民。
example.jyutping: zing3 fu2 teoi1 ceot1 san1 gai3 waak6 zi1 wun4 mui5 go3 bun2 dei6 nung4 man4

rows.meaning: person who works land / keeps livestock
rows.note: Use this specifically for the person who owns or runs the farm, rather than every person who works there.

example.english: That farmer is my uncle; the whole farm belongs to him.
example.traditional: 嗰個農場主係我叔叔，成個農場都係佢嘅。
example.jyutping: go2 go3 nung4 coeng4 zyu2 hai6 ngo5 suk1 suk1 seng4 go3 nung4 coeng4 dou1 hai6 keoi5 ge3
